purpose: Every defect class that a review wave has already found. An implementer must clear this register before requesting a wave. A reviewer who finds a new class must append it here in the same commit as the fix.
source: Captured agent sessions for the go-backend-replacement branch, 2026-09-01 to 2026-09-04.

defects.summary: Django accepts arbitrary cursor values and encodes cursors with Python grammar. A Go cursor parser that only accepts its own encoding diverges.
A negative or non-numeric per_page reaches Django's debug handler and returns an HTML body, not a JSON error.
Grouped and sub-grouped pagination omits aggregates and projects scalar relations differently from the flat list. Counts and multiplicity change with group_by.
Date filters accept a week-only form and Unicode variants that a naive date parser rejects.

defects.summary: Django silently ignores unsupported filters instead of rejecting them. Rejecting them in Go is a visible difference.
Semicolon separators and present-but-empty parameters parse differently in Django and Go.

Decoding JSON with UseNumber turns every number into json.Number. Truthiness and comparison helpers written for float64 fall through to their default branch, including for zero. Numeric boolean comparison accepts signed zero and underflowed binary64 zero while preserving separate string rules.
Python integers exceed int64 and Python renders floats and decimals differently from Go.

Absent, explicit null, and explicit empty are three distinct states on the wire. A Go slice or map with omitempty collapses them. Imported optional response strings can also drop present empty names. Declare source-always-present fields as required in the authored response schema and test the generated HTTP encoder.
defects.guard_scope: Assets V2 and legacy confirmation request attributes: omitted preserves current value; null, empty object, empty array and scalar stay distinct through the real parser and persistence boundary. Historical families are not replayed by this guard.

defects.summary: The guest role produces a distinct 403 body and a distinct list override. A single 403 shape is not parity.
Draft and archived resources preauthorize administrators before the ordinary permission check.

A soft-deleted membership row still joins and duplicates result rows. The duplication is source behaviour and must be preserved.
Archived and soft-deleted projects change detail-route behaviour without changing list behaviour.

Views select a read replica through a database alias. The alias changes visibility inside a transaction. Invitation ViewSets use primary reads even for GET, HEAD and OPTIONS; roster BaseAPIViews use replicas. Authentication must follow the same source selection.
The 404 body for an unknown workspace differs in casing and wording from the generic detail error.

An ordinary OPTIONS request runs DRF negotiation, authentication, and workspace authorization. A CORS preflight bypasses all three. The mount must dispatch on Access-Control-Request-Method, including when that header is present with an empty value.
A slashless URL redirects with 301 and must preserve the query string.
Accept negotiation order decides between the JSON error and the HTML debug page.

Update the measured Django component count alongside discovery/included counts; do not add redundant per-method literals when the complete method Counter already checks the same invariant. Parity evidence paths were typed from memory instead of read from the filesystem. Commit d310b836b5 wrote 150 references to seven recorder files that never existed, because it dropped the test_ prefix that every other parity file uses. Nothing read those paths, so the evidence claim for six retired families stayed unverifiable until the gate checked it.

A review wave was opened before the verification battery ran. Generation rewrote the transport tree and a Docker integration test then failed, so the first two waves were cancelled mid-flight and a third was lost to a reviewer sandbox fault. defects.summary: A bare scripts/ rule in .gitignore matches any directory of that name at any depth, so a new skill script is invisible to git add and is silently dropped from its commit. The progress skill's script had been force-added around it.

This module holds several independent Loom design trees, so vetting one family's design always reports generated-design-skew against every other tree. The exit code is non-zero and the output reads as a real failure.

internal/proxy/caddy_integration_test.go asserts the upstream for hand-written route literals. Every retirement invalidates some of them, and the failure surfaces only after a Docker container round trip, which costs the open review wave as well.
A correction made in the working tree while another agent held the same file staged was lost when that agent rewrote the file from its own copy. 150 corrected evidence paths reverted silently.

defects.summary: A gate that reports the same findings on every run trains everyone to ignore it. The first repository-wide run reported 73 blocking findings that no current slice can close, which would have made the whole gate advisory in practice.
A parity ledger omitted recorded fixtures. The evidence looked complete, but ten source cases had no route-inventory reference.
Generated OpenAPI warnings included checkout-specific absolute paths. The artifacts changed when a different host generated them.
The AIO image and proxy policy omitted the Go runtime. Retired routes therefore targeted an unavailable upstream.

A generic proxy matcher redirected malformed UUID paths. Django must keep malformed paths instead of receiving redirected canonical URLs. Preserve per-path converter differences: invitation session URLs use UUID converters, but the v1 DRF router accepts arbitrary lookup strings before handler validation.
The AIO workflow used a build context that excluded files copied by its Dockerfile. Remote builds failed before image creation.
Unsupported methods on fully retired paths fell through to Django. They must reach Go so its router returns the canonical 405 response.
Fixture references did not prove runtime parity. Recorded cases must replay against the real Go server and compare observable results.
A proxy test used a stock Caddy container and surrogate upstreams as proof of AIO packaging. Deployment proof must build and inspect the production image, supervisor configuration, and Go binary.

Compatibility middleware returned 405 before activity authentication, permissions, throttling, and audit effects. Retired handlers must preserve Django authentication and permission ordering before method dispatch.
Replica environment validation ran before command-line parsing. An explicit read-replica URL could not override incomplete component variables.

A guard named a test function that does not exist. `go test -run` on that name matches nothing and exits zero, so the register claimed a protection that never ran. The same failure as a parity evidence path pointing at no file, one level up.

Unsupported activity methods reused GET permission semantics. Project guests reached throttling and a 405 response instead of receiving Django's pre-dispatch 403 response. API identifier routes use identifier membership only for safe methods; unsafe methods fall back to absent project_id and deny before throttle/405.

Fully retired slashless paths were handled by Caddy redirects or fell through to Django. Both slash forms and every method must route through Go so compatibility statuses, CORS, and API audit effects stay observable.

Session-authenticated protocol methods skipped Django timezone initialization. An invalid user timezone therefore changed OPTIONS and unsupported-method responses after migration. Method-aware route families must use the method-aware resolver in shared session middleware; the legacy path-only resolver can omit new archive routes entirely.
API-key parity fixtures hard-coded an empty effect list, and the runtime parity server used an unreachable broker. Authentication audit jobs could disappear while parity still passed.
Handwritten protocol mounts duplicated a designed OPTIONS route, bypassed Loom's derived HEAD helper, and hid both behind a generic route-outside-design suppression.
Differential replay covered CORS preflight only on canonical paths. Every declared path form must exercise preflight so slashless proxy drift cannot hide behind ordinary OPTIONS coverage.

One successful API-key fixture proved audit publication while invalid, expired, inactive-user, and malformed-identifier branches omitted the same authentication effect. Every API-key fixture must declare and replay its audit job.

RabbitMQ proof searched delivery text for fragments. Durable-effect parity must decode every Celery envelope and compare exact count, task, routing properties, persistence, and normalized payload fields. Normalization must preserve null timestamp values instead of replacing them with a timestamp marker; null and populated audit fields have different meaning.
A proof receipt could pass without validating the differential receipt for the same tree. The full battery must include the family gate after all replay cases complete.

Alias routes declared only broad success fixtures and did not inherit the canonical route's branch contract. An alias must name its canonical operation and satisfy the same authentication, status, query, and protocol branches.

Loom verification tolerated generated-design skew in the selected tree and ignored warnings on successful exits. Only unrelated design-tree skew and the exact raw-response stream-fixture limitation are tolerated; all other selected-tree warnings and errors block proof.
Audit IP attribution trusted the leftmost X-Forwarded-For value from every peer. Client identity must use Loom request metadata with an explicit trusted-proxy policy.

A server-only migration generated public clients and exposed the session cookie as a payload credential. Server-only metadata and transport-owned session authentication must keep credentials out of generated payloads and clients.
Raw otelhttp instrumentation named spans from concrete request paths and created unbounded cardinality. Server tracing must use Loom observability and emit a stable service span name.
Alias branch coverage was pooled with canonical-route fixtures. Every alias must have route-specific fixtures for its inherited authentication, status, query, and protocol contract.
Alias differential cases did not inherit canonical query dimensions. Differential replay must resolve alias contracts before generating malformed query cases.
A generated OpenAPI artifact was omitted from the staged retirement tree. Proof must reject any generated output that changes the reviewed tree.
The proof battery accepted generator-induced tree drift and wrote a receipt for a different tree. Every proof step must preserve the initial base, index, worktree, and untracked-file snapshot.

Slashless activity routes audited the outer redirect or server-error response instead of Django inner unresolved-route response. Audit effects must record the inner 404 while clients receive CommonMiddleware compatibility responses.
Unsafe protocol methods authenticated and authorized against the read replica. Non-GET, HEAD, and OPTIONS methods must use the primary database for both checks.
HTTP spans attributed the spoofable leftmost X-Forwarded-For value to client.address. Tracing must overwrite it with Loom trusted effective client address.

Slashless session routes discarded Django session-cookie expiration while transforming an inner 404 into the outer redirect response. CommonMiddleware compatibility must preserve SessionMiddleware response cookies.

An expand token that collides with a serialized scalar or JSON field invokes Django fallback expansion and can overwrite the field with its relation ID or null. Unknown non-field tokens remain ignored.
Slashless unresolved session routes ran view-local timezone validation before CommonMiddleware. Unresolved requests must redirect or fail APPEND_SLASH before view-local behavior.
Unsafe slashless session requests refreshed and persisted a session against the synthetic inner 404 even though Django finalizes SessionMiddleware against the outer 500 and does not save.
The standard CLI and Swarm release routed retired operations to go-api:8080 without publishing or starting a Go API image. Every released proxy topology must ship a reachable Go upstream.
The parity recorder snapshotted Django built-in sessions instead of Plane sessions. Session persistence changes could escape database-effect parity even when every fixture passed.

The slashless user-activity compatibility stack bypassed request-size enforcement. Oversized unresolved requests must return Django request-too-large behavior before redirects, debug errors, or authentication. Generated page writes also omitted the request-size boundary when a read mount was extended. Test the production builder rather than constructing an independent middleware stack. Registering a size wrapper on the production builder is insufficient if later generated Use calls put negotiation or session inspection outside it. Assert size precedence using conflicting Accept/format plus session-inspection and audit counts.
Unsafe slashless requests returned an empty 500 response in debug mode. Django emits a technical APPEND_SLASH error body, while production redirects the same request.
The CLI Go API service did not inherit FILE_SIZE_LIMIT, so direct Go request limits could differ from the configured proxy and Django limits.
A family sharing another family's Loom tree omitted generation and vet from its proof because design ownership was inferred only from the family name.
The proxy integration cache omitted CLI deployment and release workflow files that its tests read, allowing stale green receipts after deployment changes.
The CLI source-build path did not build the newly required Go API image, and runtime image names ignored the installer's local repository override.

A Go patch upgrade updated the module and standalone image but left the AIO builder on an older toolchain, so production packaging failed after the runtime suites passed. Check the AIO image tag against go.mod in the existing foundation pin guard.
Session-authenticated user routes carrying X-Api-Key conditionally enqueue the API audit task, but the contract and durable-effect fixtures declared no user-route effects.
Debug APPEND_SLASH compatibility ignored Django technical-response media negotiation, while differential replay normalized every HTML 500 and hid unrelated body drift.
Loom UUID format validation rejected UUID-shaped values with non-RFC variant bits that Django's URL converter accepts, changing decode-before-authentication behavior.
Negative per_page handling diverged when cursor direction changed the failure order, when the cursor page was negative, and when the Python integer exceeded Go's int64 range.
Slashless malformed UUID paths matched the synthesized canonical route before validation and returned redirect or debug responses instead of Django's unresolved 404.
Django technical error negotiation treats an explicitly empty Accept header, zero-quality HTML ranges, and parameterized HTML ranges as plain text rather than HTML.
Differential replay checked only that credential values were supplied. Invalid credentials could make every authenticated case compare equal at 401 or 403 and still produce a passing receipt.
The module upgraded Loom while the executable foundation-pin check and version documentation still asserted the previous release.
A concurrent Django session deletion or update during response refresh returned Go's server-error response instead of Django's SessionInterrupted bad request.
Conditional API audit logging ran after Django session response finalization, so a concurrent session failure could suppress an audit task emitted by Django before that failure.
The Django contract proof cache omitted route and view trees, allowing removed or changed Django handlers to reuse a stale passing contract result.
User-activity requests with an API key skipped durable audit logging when slash rewriting or session inspection produced the response before the ordinary compatibility middleware.
Proof component cache keys omitted embedded inventories, generated contracts, serializers, models, migrations, and other non-Go files consumed by Go and Docker test commands.

The Plan, Matrix, Bundle, Check, Differential, and RunChecks entry and proof paths did not consistently reconcile explicit-family manifests with the route inventory, allowing partial assignment, a same-family extra, cross-family ownership, an unknown operation, or invalid pre-activation state to escape fail-closed validation.
Pre-activation proof deferral suppressed contract-shape validation together with unavailable activation evidence, allowing an incomplete Django-only entry contract to pass.
Lifecycle checkpoint accepted nonexistent or mistyped inventory families, allowing records that could not belong to a route-family slice.
Process-owned mkdir checkpoint locks survived crashes and permanently blocked future lifecycle records.
A contradictory failure verdict could be smuggled into PASS evidence, allowing a lifecycle checkpoint to record a phase whose evidence declared failure.
Hard-linked report paths could reuse the same underlying report identity, allowing one evidence artifact to support multiple lifecycle records.
The same staged tree could be reused across different route families, allowing distinct family checkpoints to claim one implementation state.
A POST-only anonymous auth_profile endpoint made differential verification require an impossible successful GET probe.
The session-CSRF branch existed only in direct assertions and not in replayable fixtures.

Request codec and media-type branches were not persisted for replay. JSON-only raw decoders can reject supported form and multipart requests, accept trailing JSON, or ignore unsupported content types; characterize each distinct parser path and require complete-document parsing.
The recorder assumed the default configurable throttle rate.
The existing autoset user branch omitted the SMTP-off and magic-off conditions.
Entry characterization promised the full method/path and CORS matrix while freezing only canonical POST and ordinary OPTIONS, and it did not bind the recorded OPTIONS fixtures to the operation.

CSRF fixtures did not prove enforced anonymous acceptance or authenticated cookie-only, header-only, malformed, mismatched, trusted-origin, and untrusted-origin combinations. Password-write source fixtures must enable CSRF enforcement and carry real matching cookies/headers; Django APIClient defaults bypass this production requirement.
Per-route threshold fixtures did not prove same-client-IP saturation, different-IP isolation, authenticated-session bypass, or the concrete throttle-cache mutations behind those outcomes.
Entry fixtures covered only unencrypted database rows and did not characterize environment selection, database versus environment precedence, encrypted rows, or SKIP_ENV_VAR behavior.
The entry contract claimed absent effects without observing all managed Plane tables, the mail outbox, the throttle cache, task dispatch, outbound HTTP, or storage writes.
Configuration precedence fixtures omitted the default-enabled magic-login flag, per-key database fallback, and the authoritative empty database value that must override a stale environment value.

Source readiness, target lookup and self-edit checks may precede request-body parsing. Eager shared parsing changes their error precedence and rejects bodies that reads, deletes or leave operations never access.

defects.summary: Configurable throttle parsing rejected negative rates that Django REST Framework accepts and enforces as deny-all limits.
Throttle rejection emitted Retry-After when Django REST Framework had no available request slot for a negative, zero with history, or overfull limit.
Signed wait arithmetic overflowed for an extreme negative throttle rate with retained history and incorrectly emitted Retry-After.
Zero-rate throttle coverage omitted the Django REST Framework distinction between an empty history with a full-window wait and a non-empty history with no wait.

Strict query parsing drops malformed escapes, invalid UTF-8 replacement spans differ from Python, and generated scalar decoding selects the first duplicate unless Django last-value selection is applied after tolerant decoding.
Dropping empty query components or collapsing repeated scalars before the existing field-limit consumers hides the original 1000-field limit.
Shared query normalization can rewrite public metadata audit records and request-log URLs unless every normalized request captures its original query and both log consumers use it.
Checkpoint verification refreshed the real Git index while computing its tree, causing a naturally dated review report to fail freshness checks even when content was unchanged.
A copied Git index received a fresh timestamp and hid same-size racy-clean unstaged edits from checkpoint verification.
Arbitrary JSON values were decoded through float64 in service adapters and Sticky response or form normalization, rounding integers above 2^53.

Raw JSONValue request persistence retained decimal and exponent tokens instead of Python binary64 values, making stored JSON disagree with Django and derived filters. Lifecycle JSONField persistence must apply the same existing normalizer before jsonb storage. Keep this finite-only rule at persisted JSONFields; decoded requests may contain ignored overflowing exponents while their finite siblings still require binary64 normalization.
A generator upgrade changed a nullable binary string contract into base64-constrained JSON without explicit design metadata.
Go's test-result cache reused container test successes after external Docker build inputs changed, defeating the proof tool's broader input digest.
Raw JSONValue decoding accepted integer tokens exceeding Python's 4300-digit conversion limit and allowed writes the previous decoder rejected.

The gate deferred source OPTIONS timezone characterization until activation, so an entry check passed without a known mandatory source branch. Source OPTIONS fixtures now trigger the same coverage guard before route ownership changes.

Reused parity databases retained differential sessions before the first case because pytest flushed only after transactional tests. External replay now clears the pytest test database once before its first case, while preserving migrations and services.
Source OPTIONS evidence on a mixed path was assigned to an earlier Django-only method instead of the explicitly declared Go companion, falsely blocking a characterized read.
Baseline advice omitted INCLUDED counters, so following the command still left the published Django contract counts stale after retirement.
An oversized pagination offset was optimized into LIMIT0 instead of preserving PostgreSQL bigint failure. Django QuerySet.none() is the exception and must still return an empty page.
Committing an unchanged proven tree invalidated the completed differential receipt because HEAD changed. Completed evidence now compares content; active review waves still reject any base change.

A retired non-GET method emitted an all-method proxy matcher on a path that still had a Django-owned method. Every mixed path must remain method-limited, regardless of which Go method is retired; emit one complete Allow repair per path.
Family-scoped proxy checks omitted other inventory methods on selected paths, hiding overreach onto retained Django methods. Check all neighboring methods while excluding unrelated paths.

Differential authentication assumed the shortest family path had a successful GET, blocking write-only or missing-target method matrices. Contracts can declare a stable read probe; source and target must still return success.

Source OPTIONS on a mixed Django path was assigned to DELETE before GET; timezone characterization also treated authentication or permission rejection as evidence that session initialization ran. Prefer GET for unowned source companions and ignore rejected sessions. Superseded lite cycle fixtures incorrectly labeled API-key requests as sessions and are replaced by the real API-key recorder.

Throttle implementations invented a generic key format instead of using the source get_cache_key, separating Go and Django request histories. API keys use api_key:<token>, while duplicate assets use throttle_asset_<UUID>. Assert exact source keys and observe real seeded cache history during fixture replay.

Duplicate-asset migration omitted the source view's five-per-minute asset throttle even though the contract matrix named it. Exercise exhaustion, cache scope, expiry, and ordering: authentication precedes throttling; timezone and workspace checks follow it; ordinary OPTIONS and unsupported methods count; CORS preflight bypasses the view.

Routing ownership of HEAD and OPTIONS does not imply the source allows them. Mixed-path Allow repair must omit explicitly rejected companions while preserving their routing and retained Django writes.
API-key audit coverage must recognize source-proven successful CORS preflight that never reaches authentication. Ordinary OPTIONS and rejected requests still require audit evidence.
A failed proof step retained only its output tail, discarding the actual assertion and forcing a diagnostic rerun. Persist complete failed-step output in a private proof log and report its path.

A null expanded relation can invoke DRF serializer initial writable fields rather than an empty object. API cycle null estimate expansion must preserve the actual EstimatePointSerializer(None).data representation.

PostgreSQL base64 inserts newlines after 76 characters while Django BinaryField uses unwrapped b64encode. Source and real Go fixture replay cover 128-byte values in issue lists and expanded cycle-issue detail.

API-v1 content negotiation can reject before inner audit middleware. Capture exactly one durable audit at the outer response boundary, after final JSON indentation, while keeping preflight and request-size rejection outside authentication and audit. Protocol HEAD responses must retain their rendered error body until this audit boundary captures it; only the outer wire boundary suppresses the body. Session page writes have the same outer-boundary requirement: a rejected Accept or format must still be audited when X-Api-Key is present.
Stale Django route/security snapshots were found only after expensive Go and parity suites. Run the cheap Django contract step before those suites to fail early without dropping verification.

Family proof replayed unrelated parity families after every local change. Select only the active family tests and reject an unknown boundary. Retired families keep Go regression tests without historical Django replay.

Raw PostgreSQL or indented metadata JSON crossed Django gzip minimum length, changing Vary despite identical JSON values. Compact JSON before the shared response compression boundary. A streaming-description read exception must match GET/HEAD as well as the path; otherwise short PATCH and OPTIONS responses acquire incorrect compression headers.

API-v1 renderer rejection returned before session Vary bookkeeping. Django 404 format and 406 Accept failures include Cookie, origin even when token authentication is not reached. Preserve the header at the shared negotiation response boundary.

The audit gate treated a present empty X-Api-Key header as an authenticated audit trigger. Preserve the empty safe value in source fixtures and require an effect only for a nonempty credential or API-key principal.

Concurrent source verification and focused recording shared Redis history, contaminating otherwise isolated database transactions. Serialize commands sharing database, Redis namespace or broker vhost.

Query values could overwrite module_id extracted from the URL because the shared API payload protected-path list omitted that key. Protect module_id and preserve source URL precedence. Work-item OPTIONS must forward only its filters query; a query issue_id must not override the path pk used for metadata lookup.
Timestamp normalization recursed into module description_text and description_html JSON values. Both are opaque model JSON fields and must preserve timestamp-looking nested strings.

Expanded user/project asset URLs lost Python None path segments and returned null instead of omitting the URL when workspace access raises AttributeError. Shared API relation serialization now preserves both branches.

A module-specific OPTIONS expectation was also applied to an existing workspace-member test. Keep new route assertions scoped; the existing inventory proxy test must retain its original routing expectations.

BaseModel.save clears explicit audit users outside an authenticated request. Nested asset fixtures must set created_by after creation and assert a populated expansion, so an empty relation cannot masquerade as omission coverage.

A shared session inspector validated timezone before route permission classes, although source initial() checks classes first. Protocols must opt in to principal-only inspection while retaining rotation and session response effects.
A requests cookie jar omitted expired Set-Cookie deletion instructions and produced false parity failures. Replay must capture response header instructions rather than only retained cookies.

Treating multipart file content as text or using Go-only numeric and UUID parsing changes DRF serializer results. Preserve uploaded-file types, Python float grammar, and integer versus boolean parent IDs.

JSON decoder error reasons and positions differ across Python and Go, and DRF distinguishes JSON null from other non-object values. Record the source branches and test the translated error envelope. Valid non-object JSON also reaches different operation policies: direct serializers return400, .get raises500, and member role-membership checks distinguish iterable values before serializer access. Audit every parser caller through its first source data access before sharing error policy.
Differential compared Vary field order literally and inspected only its first line. Compare all case-insensitive cache-selection fields while retaining missing, extra, and wildcard differences.
A custom HTTP500 error lacked Loom Fault() metadata even though generated HTTP encoding passed. Family Loom vet must validate design semantics before review.
Go Unicode whitespace trimming omits U+001C through U+001F accepted by Python str.strip. This accepts blank label names and preserves boundary characters that Django removes.
DRF optional HTML fields skip empty form values, while JSON empty strings still validate. Preserve form input identity before FloatField validation.
DRF FloatField limits original string length and rejects overflowing integers before saving, while floating-point infinity remains supported. Preserve source numeric types and coercion.
Python UUID coercion accepts compact URNs, flexible braces/hyphens and Unicode decimal hex digits that a canonical UUID parser rejects.
DRF prohibited-surrogate validation stops at the first character in each field; joining all surrogate values changes the source error envelope.
An explicit generated error schema can silently discard source response keys. Replay recorded client-error bodies through the generated server before activating a family.

Flattening form fields loses repeated list values; DRF ignores indexed-only lists during partial updates but parses them on full creates. Preserve both scalar last-value access and ListField extraction.

Native integer path schemas narrow Django string-based identifier lookup: Unicode decimal digits, whitespace and beyond-int64 strings must reach source-compatible lookup instead of failing transport conversion.

A raw FK writer was marked characterized using only local happy paths, and a seed named foreign was only another project in the same workspace. Record distinct cross-workspace ownership, valid cross-project contrasts, and partial-write/effect failures before implementing the writer.

Reading only DRF Response.data silently records null for Django JsonResponse errors, including middleware413 and unresolved-route404. The shared source recorder now preserves DRF data and decodes native JsonResponse bodies.

A global relation-name map can mistake a scalar field such as description for a foreign key and emit null instead of the source value. Prefer the *_id column only when the database row contains that column.
Bulk date updates queue activities before model date preparation; eager type validation loses durable source effects on a later invalid value.
Activity payloads contain serialized JSON strings whose field insertion order is observable. Nested serializer and form field ordering must preserve the source order.
A query reference such as issue_id is dropped when every resource-like query name is treated as a path parameter; protect only the actual decoded path fields.

Archive-detail serialization has only the subscription annotation. Do not synthesize omitted list-only annotations as null or empty fields. Page create, metadata update and duplicate also have different annotations; distinct write schemas must match recorded success responses without weakening existing read contracts.
The default assignee is included only when it passes the project membership/role filter; a guest or nonmember default must not leak into the created issue projection.

API intake nested updates project the related issue after the nested save, while the app route uses its preloaded issue snapshot; relation snapshot timing is route-specific and observable in the response/effects.

Multipart source fixtures include the deterministic wire boundary in raw audit data. The source and target clients must preserve repeated field values and canonicalize that boundary before comparing audit snapshots.
A Django queryset without model ordering uses primary-key ordering for first(); selecting the earliest creation timestamp changes the default issue type.
Older protocol wrappers can intercept OPTIONS before a newly retired family. Exercise the actual production composition, including collisions with retained methods.
Resolver failures for encoded slashes precede endpoint authentication but still produce the source API audit task for a valid key, without updating its last_used value.
Request-size rejection precedes view dispatch and session response decoration; prematurely installed Allow and Vary Cookie headers diverge from Django middleware errors.

API audit coverage must distinguish a source-proven request-size middleware rejection from endpoint responses. An exact oversized-body 413 with no writes/effects may precede audit; missing-body 413 and authenticated resolver 404 still require evidence.

Async MobX store actions lose action context after awaiting service calls; apply each returned record, related counts or ordering, and loader cleanup atomically inside runInAction so observers see a consistent update and strict action enforcement remains satisfied.

Escape closed member and priority pickers without returning keyboard focus to their trigger. Retain the trigger element and restore focus after the picker closes; the member picker's first Escape still clears a nonempty search.

An identifier rendered as a copy button inside a menu trigger created nested interactive buttons. Render passive identifier text when it is composed into another interactive control while preserving the standalone copy action. Page action toggles must also use one outer menu action with a non-interactive visual indicator and accessible On/Off state.

Breadcrumb loading placeholders used unstable list keys and replacing them with real breadcrumb items could emit missing-key warnings. Preserve list identity through loading and restore item navigation after loading.

Work-item errors must log safe stable error_kind and stage values for cancellation, deadline, PostgreSQL, and other failures, including failures before Execute. Access logs alone cannot distinguish cancellation from a server defect; never expose raw database, credentials, or request error details.
Collapsible title actions nested filter/menu buttons inside a disclosure button. Keep title actions as siblings of the trigger for sub-items, attachments, links and relations.
A second uncontrolled disclosure state can leave aria-expanded stale after external controlled-state updates. Preserve one effective open state, trigger identity and keyboard focus.
Frontend regression guards must accept repository tests/ paths directly and reject missing files; implementation tokens or path traversal spellings do not establish a regression guard.
Successful repeated sub-item fetches toggled issue visibility off and left preview loaders set. Use idempotent completion state updates; preserve explicit user-toggle behavior separately.
A pnpm command in a worktree sharing node_modules can relink the served checkout dependencies to unbuilt worktree packages and break Vite module resolution.
defects.reason: Every pnpm invocation in a shared-node_modules worktree must disable dependency verification; frontend suites run against equivalent source in the checkout owning built dependencies.

defects.summary: Fully retiring a formerly mixed path must retain session protocol authentication for slash redirects, CORS preflight, and unsupported verbs.
A fully Go-owned resource split between implementations must retain resource-wide Allow headers when upstream provides Allow.

DRF detail OPTIONS resolves the PUT filtered object and omits actions on handled lookup/filter failures. Static existing-object metadata advertises an unavailable action. Custom get_object implementations can instead propagate a missing-object or malformed-ID error; preserve the measured operation-specific response after authentication and permissions.

Django APIClient TRACE bypasses JSON rendering and force_bytes converts an omitted None body to the literal bytes None. An external replay client that omits that body changes durable API audit data; preserve the source wire encoding and octet-stream content type, including empty inputs. JSON requests must also use the same DRF JSONRenderer bytes on both targets; requests json= spacing changes raw durable audit bodies.

An earlier read-family proxy test kept Django expectations for membership writes and OPTIONS after their complete retirement. Update those ownership assertions together with the new family, while retaining checks for the related module entity writes still owned by Django.

When read and write families share an API path, rejected OPTIONS must retain the existing whole-resource Allow contract. Select the new metadata protocol only if its source contract actually permits OPTIONS.

Historical fixture replay repeated isolated service setup after a family was already retired. Keep source parity limited to the active unretired family, then use the normal Go regression, integration, and proxy suites for retired behavior.

A finite RFC3339 layout list rejected Django-accepted minute precision and compact timezone offsets. Reuse the Python ISO parser and preserve Django fallback forms, timezone interpretation and microsecond precision.
Bulk date validation required padded month/day values even though the source strptime and model field accepted them, turning valid writes into server errors.

App intake creation inserted a missing triage state before rejecting an existing foreign effective type. Preflight the selected tenant policy while preserving ordinary source validation precedence and partial writes.

Synthetic assertion-helper tests did not exercise mixed local/foreign endpoint branches. Preserve executable source counterexamples and compare the target HTTP response, exact domain deltas and durable messages for mixed inputs and alias precedence.
An early resolver response bypassed global CORS and returned JSON 404 for preflight. Keep resolver rejection before endpoint authentication but inside CORS normalization and preflight handling.
Encoded-slash resolver errors on app routes skipped the API-key audit middleware even though Django logs API-key requests without a route-prefix restriction.

Generated Allow middleware placed after reverse_proxy worked under directive sorting but was unreachable inside the AIO literal-order route block. Exercise the actual AIO configuration and preserve responses without upstream Allow.
Temporary proxy prefixes plus Docker service suffixes exceeded the 63-character DNS label limit; validate every resulting service hostname with a maximum-width timestamp.

Running RabbitMQ readiness diagnostics as root during startup can create a root-owned Erlang cookie before the broker starts. Run probes as the rabbitmq user; fresh pinned-container startup confirms cookie ownership.
A comment content update can write a persisted foreign-project Description even when its ID is omitted from the request. Validate the effective attached FK before writes for app and API serializers.

A source OPTIONS fixture for a missing detail object omits writable actions and cannot supply static permitted-object metadata. Keep the complete schema and omit PUT only after the filtered lookup fails.

Generated UUID query validation runs before source authorization and emits a framework problem body instead of the source field error. Keep filters opaque in transport and validate them in the authorized domain. The same precedence applies to DRF-router invitation lookup strings: generated UUID format checks must not run before API authentication. Keep malformed-lookup 400 local to parsing; changing the shared missing-object mapper silently changes genuine 404 responses.
A typed nil user map renders as an empty object inside Python-compatible activity snapshots instead of source null. Return a nil interface for missing nested user projections.

Comment deletion queue order differs between app/API and public board handlers. App and API enqueue cleanup before activity; public comments enqueue activity first. Verify consumed broker envelopes in source order.
Public comment creation records a project public member, while PATCH only updates content and publishes activity. Sharing the creation effect with PATCH introduces unintended durable membership rows.
The issue subscription icon and loading control lacked an accessible name across desktop and mobile. Name the real button in subscribed, unsubscribed, and disabled loading states.

Custom link protocols registered after linkify initialization were ineffective, and destroying one editor reset global protocols still needed by other editors. Register before initialization, initialize late additions, and retain shared protocols during teardown.
Removing the API comment serializer with its HTTP handlers broke the retained webhook worker import. Retain serializers used by workers or neighboring routes.

Celery autodiscovery does not load task modules whose names do not end in `tasks.py`; Go API effects then fail as unregistered tasks. Explicitly import every Go-produced task module and assert the worker loader registers the producer task names.

Regenerated local proxy policy replaced the host inode; restarting Caddy retained the old bind mount and sent the smoke requests to Django. Recreate the proxy, compare policy digests, and verify fresh Go request spans.
Model TextFields were given generic CharField/URLField limits, rejecting source-valid long reactions and links.
A hostname-containing-dot URL check accepts malformed DNS labels, overlong URLs, and six-digit ports that the source URLValidator rejects.
A generic parent expansion resolves issue_comments.parent through issues and returns an empty object instead of the parent comment ID/project.
Temporary gate repositories lacked current and committed inventory after contract proof began reading both, causing collateral full-suite failures.
Operation-specific serializer validation and normalization order can differ; intentional stricter link validation and app non-object400 must have exact response/database/effect expectations.
An outer source-stack lock around the Go parity runner deadlocks its own lock acquisition; invoke the runner directly because it owns serialization.
Source mutation templates can assign UUID aliases in a different order from source failures; align the identical request identity and complete before-snapshot before deriving a changed target result.

URL regex alone misses NFKC authority rejection and applies hostname bounds to the regex authority instead of Python urlsplit hostname; preserve parsed authority and Unicode lowercase length semantics. Global whitespace rejection also differs from the source DNS character class; compare the complete shipping-source branch table.
A family-owned Loom design tree whose path uses only some underscores from the family name is not discovered by the proof lifecycle, silently omitting generation and Loom vet.

Sorting rows by random generated primary keys before assigning canonical UUID aliases makes equivalent relation rows compare differently. Permit explicit semantic table ordering before alias assignment while preserving identifiers, foreign keys and row counts; assert incorrect relation assignments still differ.

Adding a write-family protocol wrapper on a mixed-ownership path can intercept HEAD already owned by its retired GET family and regress a live 200 into raw remaining-Django 405. Preserve existing GET/HEAD dispatch on collection and detail while new write-only paths keep their own authorization and method semantics. Reuse the existing passthrough mechanism: widening the write owner Allow string to restore reads corrupts source write/error/OPTIONS headers.

Converting JSON values before source validation changes DRF ChoiceField identity and legacy role-cap precedence. Numeric strings can be accepted where numeric floats, booleans, and whitespace are rejected, while legacy bulk role caps run before integer coercion. Preserve operation-specific source ordering.
A non-object legacy body can fail in view guards before serializer validation or project lookup. Treating every non-object body as a generic 400 changes source status and effects.

An in-process DRF response can retain HEAD data absent from its wire body, and a requests adapter can omit sent cookies from recorded request metadata or expose hop-by-hop framing headers. Compare wire semantics while preserving separately observed audit data and actual session cookie names/values.

A declared project-role whitelist is narrower than any active membership: legacy bulk writes can persist other smallint roles. Preserve the explicit allowed role set and workspace-admin override before action guards.

Unsupported methods still run source method-specific permissions before throttling and dispatch. A read-only operation name must not apply safe-method permissions to POST or other unsafe protocol requests.

DRF JSONField decodes HTML form strings as complete JSON, while JSON request string values remain strings. Ignoring the transport input identity stores a JSON string instead of an object and accepts malformed JSON.

Django ORM UUID lookup coercion differs from serializer PK validation: malformed strings/floats return validation400, missing/null and nonexistent integer/boolean IDs return404, and unhashable bulk map keys fail500 before lookup. Preserve each source stage.

Scanning a nullable membership foreign key into a Go string changes the source downstream missing-workspace-member404 into a scan500. Preserve null identity through the next source lookup. Cycle creator and owner columns are also nullable; preserve those identities through permission checks instead of failing the shared resource lookup.

DRF PrimaryKeyRelatedField rejects boolean IDs with a type-specific error before UUID lookup. Reusing a UUID-only failure changes the public serializer error body. Malformed UUIDs and missing valid keys also retain their distinct source messages and original supplied spelling.

Reusing request choice and nonnull constraints for responses excludes stored rows that Django can return: bulk insertion can persist other smallint roles, and partial updates can retain a nullable member. Keep strict request validation but model the full source response domain.

Django builds the complete member dictionary before ordered workspace lookups; eager UUID parsing overrides earlier missing-row or role-cap outcomes. Equal Python numeric keys retain the first key and last role, while the subsequent ORM filter coerces every original input again.

A UUID accepted by ORM lookup can retain a noncanonical request dictionary key. Existing-member canonical-key misses map to Django KeyError400; new-member property sort-order lookup uses the original spelling and can miss a canonical map entry.

Django prefers AMQP_URL over CELERY_BROKER_URL. Configuring only the latter let an asset recorder drain a different family's test queue. Assert the isolated database and the recorder's effective broker address match Celery before cleanup or consumption.

A public signed-download redirect was treated as missing authorization coverage because only anonymous 2xx responses counted as public. Accept recorded anonymous branches only with preserved AllowAny and anonymous OpenAPI security declarations; a login redirect alone must not bypass the authorization gate.

Deleting a URL can also remove source-broken methods excluded from the stable retirement inventory. Subtract those methods from Django discovery only, reading the committed manifest so contract regeneration cannot hide them.

Exact differential equality can pressure a replacement to reproduce known bugs. Accept only documented response projections for named cases with exact old and new values, retain all other fields and immutable source evidence, and prohibit authentication-probe or cookie exemptions.

BaseModel.save replaces creator fields from CRUM even when Manager.create receives created_by_id. Outside a request this silently produces ownerless assets and false missing-row results. Persist the intended fixture creator explicitly and assert the stored creator and lifecycle flags before recording requests.

The shared protocol path validator treated asset_key as a UUID, returning HTML404 before valid legacy filename routes reached their handlers. Keep source str-converter parameters distinct from UUID parameters, including filenames with dots, spaces and Unicode.

Generated asset handlers were mounted without their path shapes in the shared session protocol resolver. Session inspection was skipped and authenticated public-asset writes reached the handler as anonymous. Every session-aware shape, including optional-auth reads and restore actions, must resolve before inspecting the principal.

Protocol case deduplication removed executable cases while retaining their immutable source fixtures. Fixture counts and contract references alone then overstated replay coverage. Every canonical fixture basename must map to a unique selectable case, and complete replay must execute the entire corpus.

The Go S3 SDK rejects an empty region even with a fixed custom endpoint, while Django accepts Plane's local AWS_REGION=empty configuration. Preserve that signing scope for custom endpoints and distinguish an explicit empty region from an absent region that uses the provider default.

An ad-hoc Django source run can remove the shared test database at teardown when --reuse-db is omitted, leaving the next Go server unable to start. The asset recorder retains its isolated schema automatically, and the Go runner creates and migrates only a missing isolated target database.

Replacing Django .get(asset=...) with ORDER BY and LIMIT 1 changes duplicate-key failure into a successful mutation of an arbitrary row. Legacy asset delete and restore must reject multiple matches without database or durable effects.

External-effect observation can mask the actual parity failure when it assumes a presigned policy or lacks Django response header access. Preserve no-upload observations and case-insensitive response header lookup so response, database and storage comparisons report the original behavior.

A response media type stored only in encoder context is not emitted for a bodyless redirect. Model the source Content-Type as a generated response header so all signed-download 302 operations preserve it without a body encoder or route-specific middleware.

A compile-ready message became stale when a domain writer resumed interface edits before the replay built its target. Require a fresh paused-writer acknowledgment and release writers only once the binary and server are ready; final proof remains frozen.

Ad-hoc recording inherited quoted app URL and different API throttle settings, creating a new fixture incompatible with the existing source corpus. Pin equivalent source and target fixture configuration and test the effective settings; preserve original records and rerun source when correcting recording inputs, never normalize mismatching effects away. Diagnostic target replay also requires the retained service stack before container setup, preventing accidental signed-URL authority changes.

Reusing a generic asset insert can omit a required project relation or set entity_identifier where the source only populates a typed relation. Preserve the exact per-operation write set for attachment creation and copied assets.

Legacy requests can create FileAsset rows without workspace or user relations. Relation-filtered cleanup left those rows behind and contaminated later target snapshots. The guarded isolated family database cleanup now removes every FileAsset row and rejects residual rows before seeding.

defects.area: new source fixtures on intentionally changed routes
defects.summary: New multipart fixtures retained original Allow headers but were omitted from the existing ASSET-001 decision sidecar, producing false parity differences. The executable corpus guard now requires and validates exact response projections for fixtures on changed method/path pairs. Canonical differential probes also need exact status/body projections for every sidecar invalid method and HEAD companion, including discovery-only methods. Invitation project-detail HEAD characterization likewise needs the accepted admin-only ACL projection; import-time source preflight rejects successful ordinary-member invitation reads left in the unchanged replay set.

Legacy FileAsset relation validation used the nonexistent comments table and assumed every relation has deleted_at, causing valid user relations and missing comments to return500. Match the actual IssueComment table and each related model default manager; real writable-field and missing-relation fixtures guard the SQL boundary.

API and app IssueAttachmentSerializer classes have different declared fields and read-only sets. Sharing one output shape alternately broke API omission and app inclusion of asset_url, including activity current_instance. Preserve each caller serializer contract and verify both API and app fixtures together.

Asset service lookups mapped any repository failure to404, hiding database errors; missing-row bodies also differ across source view bases. Preserve non-not-found errors and translate only explicit missing rows at the operation boundary. Related-user database lookup failures must remain server errors instead of invented field-validation failures. Invoke real service operations with failing repositories so helper-only tests cannot conceal missing wiring.

Legacy asset GET methods declared populated union results but omitted the HTTP response body mapping, so generated encoders returned null. Missing response identities also shifted normalized database UUID aliases and removed compression Vary; repair the canonical transport body mapping rather than normalizing those secondary differences. Preserve existing response-header corrections when reimporting the family design.

defects.area: attachment menu semantics and keyboard state
defects.summary: An attachment row wrapped its menu trigger in another button. The shared menu also maintained separate click and Headless UI open states, so keyboard activation could report expanded without displaying items. Keep attachment actions as sibling controls and let Headless UI own normal menu opening and closing; cover real tooltip/menu rendering, keyboard opening, Escape focus return, pointer selection, and disabled controls.

A live source proxy comparison inherited test settings that force DEBUG=True despite DEBUG=0 in its environment, yielding development-only500 responses on slashless writes. Anonymous30/minute throttling also exhausted the large method matrix. Verify effective production redirect/error settings and equivalent isolated throttle capacity with representative probes before the full differential; keep request-parity fixture settings unchanged. Source and target must have independent live Redis namespaces when anonymous requests share a client-address budget; never increase the production limit to hide comparison traffic.

A large passing comparison was followed by cheap gate failures: an unsupported PUT fixture was declared under POST and a custom --out replaced the canonical differential receipt. Run the static gate before comparison, allowing only its missing or stale receipt result; keep unsupported-method evidence separate from an operation's required fixtures and statuses. Write the default canonical receipt and copy it for external review afterward.

Raw map error declarations lacked required retry/fault metadata. Pinned Loom alpha.8 ErrorExpr.Finalize also drops outer metadata when synthesizing a named type for a raw map. Import named map types with the same synthesized names, attach Temporary/Fault in the error DSL, and verify the evaluated design rather than textual annotations alone. Preserve generated wire schemas and service identifiers.

A validation test inherited protocol companion metadata from the first production inventory operation. Retiring that operation made the intended missing-metadata case valid and failed the full Go suite. Explicitly set the method and clear metadata when constructing the negative case; do not rely on inventory order or retirement state.
Attachment mutation authorization must exclude soft-deleted issues before either project-membership or creator exceptions; a surviving FileAsset does not restore issue access.

API attachment downloads authorize any active project membership and do not resolve the path issue. Reusing write-role or issue-existence checks rejects valid downloads and changes permission precedence.
Repeated API attachment confirmation must preserve the original creator after the first uploaded transition; changing the creator also changes creator-based permissions.
Confirmation activity must serialize the selected project-scoped FileAsset, not re-fetch it with the path issue and silently publish a null current_instance.
Replacing a profile asset must clear the matching legacy image URL in the same update, or deleting the replacement exposes the old image again.
A no-op profile relationship hook for other entity types must not skip the unconditional user FileAsset upload and attributes update.

FileAsset JSONField attributes accept arrays and scalars. Restricting the stored value to a Go map rejects valid confirmation and makes later non-object row lookups fail. Preserve JSON and require an object only at source-proven member-access boundaries.
Public upload catches malformed size conversion and returns its own 400 body; blindly propagating a shared parser error changes that branch to 500.
DuplicateAssetEndpoint leaves draft entity associations unset. Reusing the creation mapping writes an issue relation or introduces a foreign-key failure absent in source.
Logical deletion and tombstoning are distinct: generic API asset GET explicitly excludes is_deleted even when deleted_at remains NULL after a legacy deletion.

The active asset parity runner retained a frozen count of 339 after the canonical corpus grew to 371. Focused replay passed but full container replay would fail late. The static gate now compares the full replay count with canonical source fixtures before proof, excluding corrected decision records.

A source verification artifact was a hand-written command/result summary, and the original stdout was lost during compaction. Reconstructing a report is not execution evidence. Capture stdout/stderr and exit status directly and preserve them before handoff; rerun only the affected immutable cases when execution evidence is unavailable.

PROJECT_COVER upload and duplicate handlers can crash on duplicate project_id arguments before applying entity/project validation. Preserve the source-verified matching success, mismatch or missing-entity 400, and foreign-workspace 404 boundaries.

A shared missing-issue lookup repair was applied only to POST while PATCH and DELETE retained a different 404 body. Audit all callers and preserve exact source errors before any attachment mutation or task.

API attachment download checks active project/user membership before workspace-scoped asset lookup. Reusing workspace-filtered membership changes mixed-workspace rejection from 404 to 403. Keep the download predicate distinct from workspace asset consumers.

Project existence must use the default Django manager soft-deletion predicate before rows are created or copied, including explicit ordinary duplicate destinations and implicit PROJECT_COVER destinations. Project relationship hooks must also honor the active Project manager at each caller while preserving source ordering and effects: workspace cover PATCH/DELETE skip project and previous-cover mutations for a tombstoned Project but still apply the FileAsset lifecycle, while bulk cover association commits the FileAsset project link before its later active-Project lookup returns 404. Do not apply an explicit parent-manager lookup predicate to source operations that only join the related row.

defects.summary: Replacing a workspace PROJECT_COVER must not rewrite an already soft-deleted prior FileAsset. Preserve its deleted_at and updated_at values, deleted state, object key, and project relation; generic temporal normalization can hide an unintended timestamp rewrite, so compare the raw pre-request and post-request fields.

A stale Python test-overlay module shadowed the corrected mounted source and produced an invalid decision replay. Before corrected source recording, assert the loaded module path and expected source SHA rather than checking only the host file. Preserve failed evidence and rerun only affected cases.

Workspace lookup behavior is shared across all direct and transitive asset lifecycle consumers; fixing one API attachment membership predicate does not establish parity for the rest. Related workspace joins include tombstoned rows, explicit Workspace.objects lookups exclude them, and callers preserve distinct lookup, authorization, validation, missing-resource and durable-effect ordering. Keep a finite caller manifest that maps every operation reaching these helpers to source fixtures and aliases only identical dispatch paths.

A shared asset repository signature changed while the production-mount test fake retained the old method, so domain tests passed but final vet failed. Locate consumer implementations and test fakes and run their focused tests before image build or replay.

The production-proxy control integration test used a brittle total-ref count and expected Go ownership for extra path segments outside retired route patterns. Validate the required control-ref set (including missing, duplicate, and extra-ref behavior) before container integration, and assert Django fallback for out-of-manifest extra segments.

The production-proxy integration negative case appended one segment to a retired route and incorrectly assumed Go would own it, although that path can be a valid sibling legacy asset-key route. Use an out-of-manifest multi-segment path when checking fallback behavior and keep route assertions aligned with end-anchored proxy patterns.

Counting through a window on the returned page loses the total when an offset selects no rows. Preserve an independent total and source membership-created ordering; cursor offsets are page numbers multiplied by the requested page size. A page size of one cannot distinguish these contracts. Generated scalar-query compatibility must not erase invalid source per_page input before authorized service validation.

The imported transport declared status errors only on API-key methods. Session methods returned the same named service error but generated encoders treated it as an unknown fault and emitted500. Declare the measured errors and HTTP responses on every affected method and exercise the production mount for anonymous, forbidden and timezone branches.

The invitation replay rejected a valid pytest-created schema because django_migrations was absent. Plane pytest uses --nomigrations; inspect required application tables and columns instead. Pass Django the base DB URL so pytest selects the existing test DB; Go connects directly to that test DB.

Skipping audit-user field validation because save overwrites the actor, relying on database FK errors, or returning only the first invalid field changes DRF validation and can allow a cascade before rejection. Validate related fields, collect field errors, then mutate. Preserve workspace lookup precedence before API invite create body validation. Page create labels must finish list/UUID/scoped-existence validation before raw model-context failures; test combined invalid fields, not only one invalid field per request. Shared page label fields must collect every indexed child error, preserve raw missing-PK representations and aggregate with scalar-field failures in create and PATCH before mutation. Handler parent lookup and cycle guards still precede serializer aggregation; raw ORM typing and nullable relation typing are separate phases. Cover combined failures at each phase boundary.

defects.summary: A broad parity diagnostic emitted only its truncated output tail when the optional raw-log environment variable was omitted, hiding earlier failure names and forcing a repeat. The family runner now unconditionally saves complete Django output outside the candidate tree and includes its path in both pass and failure messages.

A comparison server exited before readiness because its CLI assets configuration was incomplete; separately, a requested 32-character session key was rejected by Plane SessionStore, silently generating different 128-character cookies on the source and candidate. Configure the full CLI, assert the effective session key, and compare seeded credentials before authenticated readiness probes. Preserve startup failures rather than discarding them with automatic container removal. Module differential setup also seeded a different scope from its contract paths and enabled cycles instead of modules; validate every sample/authentication probe against the seeded scope and enable the tested feature before runtime setup.

A fixture normalizer treated an OPTIONS schema object named token as a secret value, and copying that fixture into production metadata silently replaced the field schema with a string. Redact scalar credential values, preserve schema dictionaries, and independently assert metadata field structure rather than relying only on equality with a potentially corrupted oracle.

A raw JSON body decoder returned a parser error for a bodyless invitation request while Django treated it as empty serializer input. Preserve nil and zero-byte bodies as empty fields, retain malformed nonempty JSON errors, and keep authentication and object lookup before serializer validation.

Stale API-audit fixtures replaced nullable response values with timestamps, while broad timestamp or credential normalization masked OPTIONS schema metadata. Normalize only scalar strings, compare every non-HEAD API-audit response body with its HTTP response, and compare HEAD audit bodies with paired GET representations. Run corpus consistency in the normal Go suite and before target build. Rerecord source fixtures rather than changing Go to match corrupted expectations. Request tokens must use the current canonical secret alias; repeated independent normalization failures require one collecting active-corpus diagnostic before further release proof and review.

defects.summary: General-purpose mail address parsers normalize quoted local parts and do not implement the pinned Django EmailValidator grammar. Preserve valid quoted, escaped, Unicode-domain and IP-literal inputs plus source length and invalid-input rules. Preserve Python full Unicode lowercasing and operation-specific normalization before or after validation, including expanded letters and contextual sigma.
Workspace invitation batches must reject existing members before validating email grammar. Eager email validation changes the source error and removes existing-member details for mixed batches.

Converting JSON text to Python repr by replacing quote and punctuation characters corrupts embedded strings, dictionary order, boolean/null literals and numeric spelling. Render structured values while preserving original dictionary order; verify the operation error and absence of durable effects. Loading a page converted HTML to Yjs and persisted it immediately; title hydration also scheduled an unchanged metadata save. Locked-page reads therefore emitted rejected writes. Keep conversion in memory until a real document store and initialize title comparison from the loaded document while preserving later edits, retries and changes during an in-flight save.

The disconnected page fallback persisted hydrated editor state without checking live edit permission, repeatedly writing locked or archived pages. Preserve hydration but check the current isContentEditable value after fetch, including a lock during fetch, and prevent overlapping fallback calls.

A recursive cycle check filtered soft-deleted intermediate rows even though the accepted source graph includes every same-workspace page. A live descendant behind a deleted intermediary could become its ancestor and persist a cycle. Keep submitted-parent scope separate from recursive graph traversal. A corrected source oracle must bind the resolved UUID in its raw cycle SQL after ORM lookup; passing raw numeric or boolean input introduces a SQL type error. Cover valid numeric parents, rejected boolean parents, and numeric cycle rejection with existing rows.

Missing concrete sample paths passed the static gate and failed only when live differential setup began. Validate each operation sample path with the standard URL parser before runtime setup; reject missing, relative, external and query-bearing paths.

An unmapped payload attribute on a bodyless operation makes generated transport require a JSON body. Declare only path/security/header fields and exercise bodyless requests through generated HTTP dispatch.

A shared authenticator or new write handler returns the old read error type while the write DSL declares a different type; generated encoding turns intended 401/403/400 into 500. Exercise authentication and error branches through the production generated server.

Optional nullable string fields can also allow blank strings. Converting an explicit empty string to NULL changes both persisted data and the response. Preserve omitted, null, and blank identities across create and PATCH; compare the real database and response.

A neighboring delete lookup excludes the is_triage flag, but mark-default uses only the State manager exclusions for deleted rows and group=triage. Copying the stricter predicate rejects a valid ordinary-group target. Audit each source lookup independently and test an ordinary-group target with the flag set.

A declared serializer-only field can succeed on PATCH but crash ModelSerializer create when forwarded to the model constructor. Characterize both methods. The accepted correction removes validated order before creation and attaches it to the response instance without storing it or changing sequence.

Creating a replay executable inside the checkout temporarily changes the untracked digest and prevents provisional review during proof. Build in an owned sibling directory on the Colima-readable filesystem and remove it through test cleanup.

Random workspace background colors made equivalent Django and Go fixture seeds differ before response comparison. Pin random domain defaults in seed rows, preserve their comparison, and inspect seeded models before capture rather than normalizing these values away. Immutable source verification must use the same recorded seed as target replay; observing fresh random defaults during verification changes the input, not the endpoint contract.

The shared project state replay comparator reads a legacy target URL variable to validate transport-only Host/IP differences. A new family configured only its own URL and reported a false audit parity failure. Configure both names to the identical target and pass the family marker; retain strict application effect comparison.

Canonical route patterns left collection format-suffix fixtures unmatched and could assign malformed dot lookup paths to detail operations. Normalize only source-proven family format aliases before matching, retaining DRF lowercase suffix grammar and lookup dot exclusions without broadening unrelated families.

defects.summary: A corrected runtime fixture was used for replay seeding but final comparison independently reloaded its pristine bug record. This reported false response, database UUID-alias and durable-effect differences. Select the verified expected record once and pass it through both recording and complete-record comparison; retain pristine fixtures unchanged.

defects.area: nonpositive pagination validation and cursor precedence
defects.summary: The Sticky list validates cursor syntax before per_page, so per_page=0 with cursor=bad returns 400 Invalid cursor parameter., while zero with an overflowing cursor and a negative page size below signed 64-bit range return generic 500. The approved corrected runtime checks per_page <= 0 first and returns 400 {"detail":"Error in parsing"}; retain pristine records and compare against separately captured corrected-runtime overlays.

Independent parity cases reused a single source API key against Django’s shared 60/minute cache throttle, so a late authorization case returned 429 instead of its endpoint result. Reset only the fixture valid/invalid API-key throttle cache entries before each case and cleanup; preserve other cache keys and leave production throttle settings unchanged.

Transport-specific audit comparison interpreted already-normalized header and peer placeholders as raw wire values, rejecting identical records in successive replay runs. Accept only the exact placeholder declared for that field on both sides; reject placeholder/raw and mismatched-placeholder pairs, and retain the existing raw Host/IP checks.

Forced proof refresh must bypass old evidence and invalidate every selected component receipt before any proof preflight or the first step, including receipts for later steps not reached after an early failure. Clear family proof and preflight acceptance receipts before selection or digest failures, while preserving differential evidence and unrelated scopes. Save new successful results so following families can reuse them. A failed refresh must not leave stale successes available when runtime inputs change without a source change.
