defects.summary: Workspace name validation must use Unicode alphanumeric categories and code-point length rather than ASCII letters and UTF-8 byte length.
Workspace creation must apply the source URL detector and reserved/DRF slug validators with field-specific error bodies.
Django icontains searches escape literal percent, underscore and backslash; raw SQL LIKE patterns change search meaning.
Workspace creation must preserve source field-error aggregation, raw-length-before-trim precedence, optional-field limits/defaults and writable timestamps.
Omitted colors require generated defaults while explicit colors retain DRF blank/null/length validation.

View-level raw-value checks can reject values before serializer coercion, while fields passed directly to a model can accept values a serializer would reject. Characterize both boundaries: invalid scalar workspace names/slugs return the documented corrected 400 without writes, and company_role preserves Django TextField conversion through the existing Python-compatible renderer.

An external recorder can capture a valid target response and then omit returning its fixture. Reject missing or malformed recorder return values before recursive parity comparison so a recorder defect is not misdiagnosed as a response-body difference.
A family-wide OPTIONS display name replaced the names of distinct Django views. Assert complete metadata through the composed HTTP mount for every source view, not an invented family label.

Django model defaults are applied by the ORM, not necessarily PostgreSQL. A saved-view INSERT omitted is_locked=false and failed against the real NOT NULL schema; a simplified fixture schema silently supplied a database default. Exercise both workspace and project creation with the source constraints and no invented database default.

Daily analytics copied an ID-only cycle/module bounds lookup from Django, exposing foreign-project start/end dates despite scoping activity counts. Scope metadata and aggregate lookups to the authorized project. Happy-path own-project fixtures did not exercise this metadata leak.

Adding relation models globally to a family recorder changed the table-key set of unchanged pristine fixtures. Keep each capture group’s declared snapshot scope stable and compare recorder model tables with every canonical fixture before runtime replay. New chart relation cases retain their broader snapshots.

OpenAPI-only Django proof omitted existing route-retirement tests, allowing removed-class imports and stale neighboring-owner assertions to pass until review. Run non-database view retirement tests in the early Django contract step.

Analytics SQL copied soft-delete, archive and draft filters but omitted the Issue.issue_objects triage-state exclusion. Enumerate every consumer while preserving explicitly broader Issue.objects and relation-manager queries.
A project filter incorrectly changed the analytics members aggregate from WorkspaceMember rows to ProjectMember rows. Fixture memberships must distinguish those populations.
Bot project memberships must not be counted as human project members or grant project visibility. Apply the source bot filter consistently to list and detail projections.

A session protocol dispatcher that wraps an existing authorizer must forward its optional resource-existence and OPTIONS-metadata interfaces. Omitting either interface silently selects generic metadata and loses source missing-resource or guest variants on unrelated routes.

Generated Python bytecode, pytest case caches, and lint caches entered contract/parity input digests and invalidated unchanged evidence. Exclude only those generated cache directories; source, fixtures, and environment inputs still invalidate proof. Family-specific contract/parity receipt ownership is unchanged.

An applied-filter map keyed selected tags but returned unkeyed empty fragments for unselected entries, causing a React warning on filter selection. Return null for omitted children and render the real component in the regression.

An UPDATE target alias is unavailable inside a FROM-table join condition. Workspace updates failed PostgreSQL preparation before writing any row. Resolve optional asset metadata in a correlated RETURNING subquery. Overloaded timestamp functions also require an explicit bound-parameter type. Exercise both update and soft-delete statements against real PostgreSQL.

An explicit remote metrics endpoint inherited insecure transport from the unrelated global HTTP tracing endpoint. Set the metrics transport explicitly through the SDK endpoint URL and preserve metrics certificate configuration; exercise real TLS and plaintext connections.

The permissive Google UUID parser accepts arbitrary outer bytes for 38-character strings. Use the existing source-backed UUID input helper at query/body and pre-query authorization boundaries; reject malformed identifiers before SQL or effects.

Export SQL omitted default-manager deleted-row predicates for membership permission, direct workspace lookup, default project selection and export history. Audit direct managers separately from related joins; cover authorization and absence of durable effects as well as list populations.

API v1 attachment handlers copied unsafe source behavior: a collection lacked issue permission and detail operations selected project assets independently of the path issue. Bind permission, selected asset and writes to the same workspace/project/issue; denied requests must not sign URLs or publish tasks.

Published-board access is not permission to mutate another visitor’s upload. Scope public mutations by created_by_id and board project, validate target comment ownership, and reject mixed bulk selections atomically while preserving valid nonmember owner flows. Resolve only enabled live project boards with consistent tenant identity.
